meta.title: Addressing — operations vs application
meta.subtitle: operations targets directly by node rid · application uses a logical id and Framework routing

cards.title: Two independent flows
items: operations targets the managed node directly by node rid — when the node itself is the target, like a health check or an ops command.
application gives a logical id like an actor id, spot id, or channel, and Framework routing picks the current owner and an eligible node — the application doesn't hold onto a Node RID.
